skills.name: Ruins of Myriad Plagues
skills.description: Passive: Heqet is considered both a Deity unit and a Minion unit. Active: Summons 2 frogs in front of herself. They inherit 50% of her ATK and 125% of her max HP, and grant all allied minions a Shield equal to 200% of ATK. Up to 3 frogs can exist at once. When the maximum number of frogs is reached, resummons the frog with the lowest HP (eliminates the frog with the lowest HP and resummons it). Frog: Does not perform normal attacks and moves toward the nearest enemy. Active: Releases a croak, dealing DMG equal to 50% of ATK to enemies within 3 meters and reducing their Hit Rate by 25% for 5s. Up to 5 stacks. Passive: When another frog releases a croak, it also releases a coordinated croak (coordinated croaks do not trigger this effect again). Initial CD: 5s. Loop CD: 18s.

upgrades.level2: Grants all allied minions a Shield equal to 300% of ATK.
upgrades.level3: Grants all allied minions a Shield equal to 400% of ATK.
upgrades.level4: Summons 3 frogs in front of herself.

skills.name: Calamitous Croak
skills.description: Summons a frog in front of herself, inheriting 30% of Heqet's ATK and 80% of her max HP.

skills.name: Toad Creed Crossing
skills.description: Passive: When Heqet is about to fall, sacrifices 1 frog, becomes immune to this instance of DMG, and gains a Shield equal to 500% of ATK. This skill has a 30s CD.

upgrades.level2: Gains a Shield equal to 600% ATK.
upgrades.level3: Gains a Shield equal to 700% ATK.
upgrades.level4: Gains a Shield equal to 800% ATK.

skills.name: Symbiotic Blessing
skills.description: Passive: For each frog present, all allied minions gain 20% ATK, and restore HP equal to 15% of ATK every 2s.

upgrades.level4: Restore HP equal to 30% of ATK every 2s.

relic.name: Nethertoad Unsealed
relic.description: Summons 1 frog at the start of battle, inheriting 30% of own ATK and 100% of max HP. Frog Limit +1.

upgrades.level2: Reduces Toad Creed Crossing's CD to 15s.
upgrades.level3: Reduces Toad Creed Crossing's CD to 8s.
upgrades.level4: Summons 2 frogs at the start of battle, inheriting 50% of own ATK and 125% of max HP. Frog Limit +2.
